verdict.rationale: LightSprint's docs say an agent builds a plain-English change end-to-end. Larger features can be planned and handed off as a single implementation task, and the work runs in an isolated sandbox with a live preview before going to a tracked PR for engineering review. On tests, the only evidence is a 'Tests status' check in the Merge Readiness score, which shows tests are run, not that the agent writes them. Missing for 10: evidence that the agent authors tests as part of implementation, any independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end feature delivery.
